findings.summary: The dark hero uses a bespoke 3-stop hardcoded gradient and no brand mark, whereas the inverse BrandLogoMark exists precisely for dark branded headers like this.
findings.fix: Keep the gradient (it is a legitimate brand hero) but add a BrandLogoMark(inverse: true, size: 40) into the top Row (replacing or beside Icons.auto_graph_rounded) so the executive hero carries the association identity consistent with other branded headers.

findings.summary: The hero badge text color Color(0xFFCDEEFF) is a hardcoded tint duplicating the accent brand tone instead of a named token.
findings.fix: Replace Color(0xFFCDEEFF) with a token-derived light-accent (reuse the brand accent 0xFF00A8D6 as a shared const) so the hero tint is centralized rather than a one-off literal.

findings.summary: The three _ExecutiveQuickLink cards use vertical padding of only 14 with a 10px icon+label, yielding a tap target under the 44px minimum and carry no Semantics label for the icon-only visual.
findings.fix: Increase _ExecutiveQuickLink vertical padding (e.g. vertical: 18) to guarantee >=44px height, and wrap the InkWell in Semantics(button: true, label: label) so screen readers announce each shortcut.

findings.summary: The 'بوصلة القرار' section uses data.maybeWhen with orElse: SizedBox.shrink(), so during loading and on error its header shows with no loader/error/retry, inconsistent with the metrics section above which handles all three states.
findings.fix: Replace maybeWhen(orElse: SizedBox.shrink()) with a full data.when providing the same Card-based loading spinner and error/retry states used for the metrics grid above, so the section header never renders with nothing beneath it.

findings.summary: The decorative hero icon has no Semantics exclusion and no tooltip; as a purely decorative glyph it should be hidden from the a11y tree.
findings.fix: Wrap Icons.auto_graph_rounded in ExcludeSemantics since it is decorative and conveys no meaning beyond the adjacent 'الملخص التنفيذي' label.

findings.summary: The hero container uses borderRadius 26, a bespoke value not part of the documented radius scale (card 20, chip 99) used elsewhere on the page.
findings.fix: Change the hero borderRadius from 26 to the design-system card radius 20 (or a single documented hero radius) to align with the established radius scale.

findings.summary: _PriorityTile hardcodes trailing Icons.chevron_left_rounded as the RTL forward affordance rather than a direction-aware icon, which would point the wrong way if shown LTR.
findings.fix: Use a direction-aware disclosure icon (e.g. Icons.chevron_right_rounded that flips with Directionality) instead of a fixed chevron_left, so the affordance points correctly regardless of text direction.
